The '''2024 Road to Worlds''' was a [[GEMP]] league on play.starwarsccg.org, 1–18 September 2024. A list of 47 registered players, with GEMP names, was posted on 17 August 2024.<ref name="rtw24">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1428031#p1428031 Registered Players - 47], gogolen, Players Committee forum (17 August 2024).</ref> The league was live on 31 August 2024, and players could register until 4 September 2024.<ref name="rtw24b">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1428356#p1428356 League is now live], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (31 August 2024).</ref>
